NPC.Talk: Hero, do you remember the attractive innkeeper in Lorencia? Right, that‘s me! Am I even more gorgeous than before?
You can get Gems in exchange for excellent items. What can you do with Gems? You can insert Gems obtained from disassembly into other items. Remember, I am only interested in Gems.
I am Rokard, the holy God of Light. Kundun has become stronger than ever before. Soon, the world will meet its darkest times. Even I, the disciple of light, do not stand a chance against Kundun.
To help warriors out in battle, I am following my mentor around the continents to collect useful information!
Help rid Lorencia of monsters.
This is the Warehouse. The important goods needed to fight against the forces of Kundun are stored here. Don’t worry about the future and only focus on defeating the monsters.
Hey there! I bring back mounts for you. Using my special ability to control animals, I can bring back the souls of your pets and mounts. I can also cure injured pets and mounts.
I‘ve built a small lab to study the secrets of the seasons, but it is quite costly. It would be a big help if you could buy these skill stones and magic items. Can you help me out?

Ever since my parents were killed when Kundun‘s forces attacked our village, I‘ve been wandering with my two younger brothers. To support warriors who fight against Kundun... and to make a living, I am selling potions in Lorencia.
My belly is my lucky charm! Just look how I am still alive after being in the middle of all these dangerous monsters!
The assistant of Antonius, who resurrected Kundun, was my ancestor, Giovanni. As a punishment for his greed, his descendants are now suffering greatly.
You‘re looking for weapons? You‘ve come to the right place! I am the best blacksmith in Lorencia! Here, you will always get something better than you ask for!
My strength and skill are in perfect harmony and my attacks are greatly destructive. The world trembles in the wake of my rage... but my power alone is not enough to eliminate Kundun’s forces.
Knowing how to use all the elements can be fancy but scary at the same time. But we need more powerful allies to fight Kundun. A Dark Wizard as strong as me... or even stronger.

Kundun and his followers are destroying the legacy that we have built up over the years. As the best fighter among elves, I cannot stand this any longer. I will protect this land together with the resistance army.
Visit me once in a while to receive rewards that will increase your Combat Power.
As one of the 12 holy disciples of Rokard, I will help you with the holy war.

Even if we train for our entire lifetime, we don‘t stand a chance against the evil Kundun. The only way is to use the magic of the Ancient Scroll that awakens a warrior‘s level. Every time you revive, your level becomes 1 but your basic stats increase.

I, the guardian of the Spirit Queen, am supporting the warriors of Mu Continent at the request of the queen. I give blessings such as Increase Attack Power or Increase Defense to help warriors fight against the evil forces of Kundun.
All my forces have died fighting against Kundun‘s troops and only I remain. We need a bigger force to fight against Kundun. Hence, I have put a bounty on the Kundun forces.

Ever since the peaceful continent was destroyed by the invasion of the demons 10 years ago, the memories of this painful event have been lingering inside the hearts of the descendants. Warriors, remove these demons from our land. Bring back the miracles of the past and the continent will return to peace once more.
We must protect this town, the last bastion of Lorencia. Even if it costs us our lives...
The creatures of Lorencia are being poisoned by the energy of darkness. We must find the cause as soon as possible.
I’ve been guarding without rest to prevent monsters from entering this town. I hope you can relieve me from this duty one day, warrior.
We need a warrior young and swift like you!
May the light of the Angels guide your way...
What’s wrong with necromancy? Should I just let the monster kill me because I don’t want to be labeled a heretic?
Only the victorious shall return and take my place.

During the darkest era, warriors fought each other to hone their skills. They were able to quickly obtain exceptional skills and battle experience. But as the peace continued, the arena faded from memory. Now forces of evil are starting to move again, and the battles of the arena are about to unfold before our eyes once more.
Do not fear. We‘ve come to save this world. We will bring a new light to you.

During the darkest era, warriors fought each other to hone their skills. They were able to quickly obtain exceptional skills and battle experience. But as the peace continued, the arena faded from memory. Now forces of evil are starting to move again, and the battles of the arena are about to unfold before our eyes once more.
Only the One who claimed victory among the gods may take my place.
Only the bravest of men may set foot on my ship!
Protect our domain!
Protect our domain!
For the glory, attack!
I’ve trapped the monster from each region to a nether space called the Devil Square. If you train there and improve your skills, you might be able to face the evil Kundun one day.
Greetings, stranger. I am the guardian of the Spirit Queen. My duty is to talk to the wind by playing the harp and let the visitors of Noria know of the suffering of the land.
We are Goblins. You are an idiot if you mistook us for Gnomes! We need the protection of the Spirit Queen now. Spirits, are you going to help?
Don‘t worry and leave your items here. In the name of the Spirit Queen, I will keep them safe.
We have amazing Goblin crafting skills. We give strong items to warriors who fight Kundun.
Monsters have come to this beautiful fertile land. They will pay for it with their blood!
I guess my strength alone is not enough to save the forest and face off against Kundun... If only a warrior could just lend me a hand right now...
Noria is on the brink of destruction. You are right, there isn‘t much we can do. However, I will try to protect it, even if it costs me my life.
May the protection of the Spirit Queen always be with you...
How dare these filthy monsters step foot in our pure land. I cannot stand it any longer.
We must protect Noria from the monsters of darkness.
We must get rid of these nasty monsters to protect our land.
Noble Spirit‘s land. Nobody can touch it.
The Archangel sealed Blood Castle‘s entrance and made sure that nobody could open it.
This is the Warehouse. To fight against Kundun, the noble guild Akarr dispatched us to take care of the important supplies for warriors. Don’t worry about your supplies and fight freely.
Greetings, warrior! Thanks to learning the Goblins‘ mysterious forging skills, I am operating a forge in Devias. If you must go to battle quickly, don‘t forget to get your equipment repaired by me.
Hello. I am Rocky, Charon‘s pupil. At the command of Charon, I am supporting the Dark Wizards in Devias.
I am the leader of Castellan‘s Elite Guard and a warrior of Devias. My fate will be with Devias!

I once made a name as a dancer when I was young, but nowadays I just operate an inn in Lorencia. Due to my innate ability to talk and network with people, and being in this place where gossipers gather to spread rumor, I hear many things. Come find me if you are curious about anything.
As one of the 12 holy disciples of Rokard, I will help you with the holy war.
The seething blood from deep inside my body will melt away the coldness of this icy continent.
As long as Kundun lives, my heart will stay frozen!
God of Devias, please give me the strength to defeat all my enemies.
I would prefer the resistance army to defeat the monsters and the empire, and become ruler of this land.
I can sense an evil energy within the raging snowstorm. Do not let your guard down.
Spirit of the dead, my Devias! May the protection of God be with you.
Take care of the monsters quickly and you can return to the Inn to enjoy delicious food.
A cold deadly air surrounds us. I can barely breathe.
Want to prove your bravery? Draw your weapons and face Gorgon!
My divine arrow will pierce the heart of Gorgon.
The grim darkness will fade away a bright light will shine upon this land!
Fight with no fear, the Archangel’s divine light will be with you.
Due to the energy that the evil king is emitting, the monsters are respawning endlessly. Eliminate all the monsters.
I can sense Gorgon‘s energy somewhere within the Dark Prison. I’ve prepared some forbidden magic for just this situation. You can look forward to it.
Something is about to happen here. You can never go wrong trusting a woman‘s instinct.
This place is hell... I just want to go back home...
What!? Gold! Gold! It‘s all mine!!
The monsters here are really strong...
Ha! Did you think I‘d be scared? The monsters here are nothing compared to my wife!
March forward, warriors!
Balrog is the right hand of Kundun. He’s trying to unseal him right now. We must stop him.
I hope my potions help turn the tide of the battle...
If Balrog is released from the seal, we are done for. We are better off risking our lives to fight rather than waiting for that to happen.
We must stop him before Balrog is released from the seal. If we don’t, Mu Continent will sink into an abyss of despair.
At the Lost Tower... I will prove my worth.
I sense Balrog‘s strong power nearby. We‘d better not let our guard down.
Gorgon resurrected Balrog with your blood? That’s interesting.
Balrog will try to excel in battle in order to redeem himself for betraying Kundun.
You must not let Balrog and the monsters step out of the Lost Tower.
March forward, warriors!
March forward, warriors!
As long as there are monsters of Atlans threatening the peace of Noria, mercy is an indulgence.
Powerful equipment and skills are also buried here, along with the piece of Archangel‘s Absolute Weapon.
The elegance of the deep sea purifies my soul.
This is an important path that leads to the safe area. My task is to alert people when the powerful sea monster appears here.
How can I steal the piece of Archangel‘s Absolute Weapon from Hydra...
Our mission is to find the piece of the Archangel‘s Absolute Weapon, so it can be used to fight against Kundun.
Look at these records. The puzzles here would take centuries to solve. Once peace returns to Mu Continent, I would love to study the relics of Atlans for the rest of my life.
Kundun’s underling, Hydra, lives in the deep sea so don‘t let your guard down. He‘s a great evil who controls all the monsters of the deep.
Our kin has survived from countless battles. We may live in the dark for now but our soul will remain with the light forever!
The sandstorm devours the light and your sight diminishes in darkness.
I am the watcher of the desert. As long as I live, monsters will not pass through here.
Warrior! I believe that one day, you will slay all your enemies.
No creatures can survive in this harsh environment except us.
I‘ve tried to get rid of the yellow dust by summoning a tornado with magic, but it just made the field of vision worse. I tried to summon rain but the water element is nowhere to be found here.
The sand which covers the sun also covers my eyes. I can only use my senses to shoot arrows towards enemies from afar...
Greetings, looking for something?
I‘ve been waiting for the shadows of the night to fall.
If we can find the soul of the desert, we can escape from here.
To recreate the Archangel‘s Absolute Weapon, we need the Dark Phoenix Flame. I‘ve come here looking for it.
Unfortunately, Icarus is already in Kundun‘s hands. Just finding the Phoenix of Darkness will be difficult, and I‘m not sure how we will overcome all the difficulties we may face.
To complete Icarus’s tasks, strong warriors like us must take action.
Even the Phoenix of Darkness, the most powerful creature in Icarus, has not escaped from Kundun. I guess only thing we can try is to use the Dark Phoenix Flame to placate it.

This was once a path that lead to the heavens, but it has been left abandoned when it was ruined after the last war. Since then we have been keeping prisoners of the heavens here, and their souls have become corrupted.
Is this really the place I used to know? I cannot find a single hint of its former beauty.
God, if you can hear my voice, please give me the strength to defeat my enemies. If my prayer isn‘t answered, I will assume you do not exist.
Monsters in the forest are appearing through the many cracks in space-time.
The Witch Queen and Hellminer were originally the queen’s servants, but they now follow orders from Kundun.
This forest is filled with mysterious magical energy. Even the smallest streamlets are different from other places.
Just as the sun rises in the morning and sets in the evening, a flower blooming and waning is the way of nature.
The hardships of life age and weaken us, but also make us wise.
A rock may be worn down by rain and wind, but it never breaks.
This place may be a scary and ominous grave for some, but to me it is a place of vivid history.
Look! The beauty of long ago has faded, and only the remnants of broken buildings remain. That is the past.
Careful, one small branch or leaf may be a threat to our lives.
To survive in the forest, you must learn to hide all traces of yourself, to make it as if you were never there.
Look there! A huge snake!
My dream is to one day ride the golden flight vehicle to a quiet and beautiful new continent, and explore it.
Although it has become a sand-covered land of death... the great past lives on in our memories.
Light fades as time passes, but not all the glory from the past has disappeared.
I really can‘t believe a scientific civilization that was advanced enough to create such powerful creatures existed back then…
These are the relics left behind by King Kanturu. It is a masterpiece made by a great scientific civilization.
We are lucky to find shelter in such a remote place.
Still got a long way to go, when will this road end?
The view of this narrow path wouldn‘t be so bad if there weren‘t any monsters.
Quiet! If we are found, we will both be in danger.
Actually, one of the most brilliant civilizations used to be here.
Look at that precise measuring skill and powerful magic! Amazing!
I‘ve been to every part of the continent, but never to a place as mysterious as this one.
Look! A perfect combination of magic and skill! It‘s sad that such a powerful skill is being forgotten.
Look at the big hole behind me. It feels like it’s ready to devour everything in the world. I wonder what created it...
Do you see that big hole behind me? Maybe there are enemies inside getting ready to attack us?
That’s beyond amazing. How is it possible something as powerful as this can be created.
I do not want to meet death in this place.
I do not want to meet death in this place.
I do not want to meet death in this place.
Protecting this sacred snowland is my faith.
If I come back alive, my story will be handed it down from generation to generation!
(A frozen statue. Feeling comfortable standing next to it.)
Come inside! This place is safe.
God bless you.
The only thing I‘ve found since I came here is loneliness.
(The legend says this creature can purify a human‘s soul.)
Life and death are right next to each other.
Even strong waves can‘t stop me from thinking about my hometown.
There are many rare herbs on this island. You had better get as many as you can.
So many interesting things have happened on this island. Go ask the Elder Goblin when you have time.
A treasure box is full of treasure, but the key for the box is called disaster.
An evil spirit has come to this land from deep in the ocean. Only driving it out of this land will bring us peace.
I don‘t want to be those Destries. I will be killed mercilessly by my own race.
The dark force is getting stronger as the Cave of Pirates is getting closer.
The atmosphere and surroundings are perfect for spirits to dwell.
We have never set foot outside of Kalutan. Also it was rare for other races to visit us.
No one will abandon these beautiful spirits.
Refer to me as the Empress.
Do not bother me.
This chest contains all of the world‘s essence.
Welcome to Elveland.
Our people need to become stronger. The outside world will not be as peaceful as ours.
Uh…I think the dust from the butterfly wings fell in my eye…
When god gives you a gift, he makes it hard to open.
Even your times of trouble, might be to someone else a blessing.
To convince someone, you must first convince yourself.
The reason why tears always run down my eyes is because I love this land so much.
It takes true strength to cry when sad and smile when happy.
Action defeats fear, while hesitation and delay makes everything fearful.
Though my brother and I are different, we make a great duo.
Tell them to do what they want. It takes more than a little storm to scare us!
Waves don‘t scare men of the sea. Hahahaha!
Though I may be part of the crew, I‘m still afraid of sharks.
For the freedom of the Spirits!
May the aria of the Empress be with you.
We cannot let the demons invade our land once again!
I can hear the ancient calls from the Tree of Life, our ancestors were here before.
Without the Tree of Life, the spirits cannot live on.
This is the final defense line of Akeron. Don‘t let any monsters to break through it！
Winter has arrived. When will spring come again…
The task couldn‘t be done today can‘t be done tomorrow.
I saw courage and hope inside you.
It‘s not the flash of a light but the persistence that decides everything.
Those who have worked with all their heart acknowledge importance of the talent.
My heart is divided into two. One in my hometown, and other half under the Tree of life in Akeron.
More, more. And More Adventures! That is what excites me.
Sometimes you wonder what is beyond the mountain, but it turns out there is nothing special.
If you learn about the history of the spirits. You will be interested in this temple just like me.
It seems people are forgetting about me….
Body is nothing more than a container of the soul.
I cannot believe this place was once where the ancient spirits were enshrined. It‘s too dark.
Maybe the fairy dragons were created from the Tree of Life, just like the spirits.
There is no place I cannot reach!
You do not know anything about this cave!
New inventions always make money.
Watch out for everything around you. Danger will occurs at anytime anywhere.
May the great nature be with us!
Strength is useless. Knowledge is all we need!
The light in my mind has always guided myself.
This place always creeps me out. I just want to leave here!
Can you here this beautiful singing? It is so marvelous.
This place is mysterious and beautiful.
Protecting this place is my mission.
Danger waits ahead! Warriors be careful!
Our will is the cornerstone of monster’s destruction.
The power of friendship is very strong!
The glory of the past is recorded in the history books.
Even in the glory of civilization, the enemy will not be attacked by the monsters.
Welcome to Lake Necrosis
I hope our people become stronger. The outer world will not be as peaceful.
Uh…I think the dust from the butterfly wings fell in my eye…
When god gives you a gift, he makes it hard to open.
Even your times of trouble, might be to someone else a blessing.
To convince someone, you must first convince yourself.
The reason why tears always run down my eyes is because I love this land so much.
It takes true strength to cry when sad and smile when happy.
Action defeats fear, while hesitation and delay makes everything fearful.
It’s been a while I have visited here, but what happened to the place?
Arts! I can smell the scent of the art here!
I have seen the demolition of the sanctuary that once shone with my own eyes.
I came along here with the wind but can’t go further!
I am floating around as my memories are lost, but one I do remember that there was a big explosion here.
I am looking for the secret of this place and I am about to find it!
Magics, how extradordinarily fabulous it is. Although there may be obstacles to get through, we will never stop our way to chase it.

Warrior! The Archangel has sealed his body at the entrance of Blood Castle to stop the Elite Guards of Kundun. However, the Archangel has been weakened through continuous assault and asks for help from the warriors of Mu Continent. I, the messenger of the Archangel, need warriors with Cloaks of Invisibility to come with me to Blood Castle!

Welcome to the Loren Feast.
Loren‘s Ruler has prepared a great feast for you.
Loren‘s Ruler has prepared a grand feast for you.
Welcome to the Feast.
Thank you for coming to celebrate the Strongest Companions. Please enjoy!
Controlling all the elements are spectacle but dangerous. Because the magic holds the power to end the world.
Controlling all the elements are spectacle but dangerous. Because the magic holds the power to end the world.
Controlling all the elements are spectacle but dangerous. Because the magic holds the power to end the world.
My power and skills are perfect. The world will be shivering from my rageful roars.
My power and skills are perfect. The world will be shivering from my rageful roars.

As a Elf warrior I can‘t sit back here anymore. I will protect the mother earth with the resistance.

Knowing how to control all elements can be fancy but scary at the same time. Anyway, we need more powerful allies to fight against Kundun. Warriors as strong as me... or even stronger.

Kundun and his followers are destroying the legacy that we have built up over the years. As the best fighter among elves, I cannot stand this any longer. I will protect this land together with the resistance army.
I will show you what real miracles are in this doomed world.
